correctness.rationale: For f decreasing with f²=e, commuting with e forces fiber reversal; since f² fixes the roots, f must act on their ordered set by the unique reversal. The condition on a paired rail is precisely a_B=b_A=0 for monotone sequences a,b; splitting into A=0, B=0 and A,B>0 gives the exact two-variable series ((1-x)(1-y))/(((1-x)(1-y))-vxy)^2. Extracting coefficients gives (j+1)binom(L,j)binom(R,j), and independence across the mirrored pairs gives the entire pointwise fiber polynomial. Summing all side lengths gives the geometric rational generating function; coefficient extraction yields the stated joint ranks. An independent one-sided isotone count proves the benchmark. Executed verification checks every idempotent fiber on n<=9 and every paired-rail sequence with L,R<=6. Bounds and conventions are explicit; finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The new result is the target-conditioned order-reversing root polynomial and its direct aggregate equality with the already-published order-preserving distribution. The closest full published theorem explicitly counts only order-preserving maps and gives different one-sided factors; at n=5 the same fixed idempotent has different class-conditioned root polynomials. Multiple semantic and primary-literature searches found no statement covering the opposite-rail formula; unexamined general root literature remains a nontrivial priority risk.
residual_risks: 2016 bibliographic item about order-reversing quasi-idempotent generating rank was accessible only by abstract; its detailed lemmas could require further priority comparison.
An unlocated older general theorem for square roots in the full monotone transformation monoid or a general anti-involution transfer could subsume some or all of this claim.
The univariate numeric series and isotone joint ranks are already published; these are deliberately not claimed as novel independently.
The relevant partial-injection root work was compared via an indexed summary rather than a complete paper, though its underlying transformation class is mathematically different.
Scientific originality is based on inspected available evidence and not a statement of historical uniqueness.

value.rationale: Square-root fibers of natural idempotents are fundamental semigroup invariants, and order-reversal introduces a genuine paired two-cycle geometry. The exact target-by-target root-rank polynomial for arbitrary chain profiles is not a mere renaming of the known isotone formula: its coefficients can differ by a factor three for a single five-point target, yet summing globally yields exact all-rank equidistribution. The reusable paired-rail kernel and the algebraic cross-class phenomenon provide structural information across an infinite natural family; no unsupported downstream theorem is asserted.
